audit_events_actor_reference_check.name: audit_events_actor_reference_check
audit_events_actor_reference_check.value:
(
        ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'membership' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is not null and "audit_events"."actor_service_account_id" is null)
        or ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'service' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is null and "audit_events"."actor_service_account_id" is not null)
        or ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'system' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is null and "audit_events"."actor_service_account_id" is null)
      )

users_password_identity_check.name: users_password_identity_check
users_password_identity_check.value:
"users"."auth_method" <> 'password' or (
        "users"."username_normalized" is not null
        and "users"."password_hash" is not null
        and "users"."credential_version" >= 1
        and "users"."password_changed_at" is not null
      )

jobs_terminal_time_check.name: jobs_terminal_time_check
jobs_terminal_time_check.value: "jobs"."status" not in ('completed', 'completed_with_errors', 'failed', 'cancelled') or "jobs"."completed_at" is not null

prospects_merge_state_check.name: prospects_merge_state_check
prospects_merge_state_check.value: ("prospects"."status" = 'merged' and "prospects"."merged_into_prospect_id" is not null) or ("prospects"."status" <> 'merged' and "prospects"."merged_into_prospect_id" is null)

provider_operations_currency_check.name: provider_operations_currency_check
provider_operations_currency_check.value: ("provider_operations"."estimated_cost" is null and "provider_operations"."currency" is null) or ("provider_operations"."estimated_cost" is not null and "provider_operations"."currency" is not null)
